summary: Second security and consent pass over 35a059c..6c95b51 for track weekly_update_fix Phase 1. HEAD equals the supplied audited sha. The leak check now scans exactly the candidate files: every COMMIT_REL path is copied into the staging folder $CAND/docs before the scan (update.sh:232-255), leak-check.ts walks every file under $CAND/docs recursively (leak-check.ts:244-247), and the scan runs before the first docs/ write and before git add (update.sh:259-277 against 284). The private input defaults to $HOME/.local/share/lending-desk-bench/model-guide with a MODEL_GUIDE_PRIVATE_DIR override (update.sh:71); a missing input refuses with 'update: no private input' and no path (update.sh:132-134). Staging is a mktemp folder removed by an EXIT trap, so a refusal leaves no file behind; preview.sh refuses a symlink under docs/ before any write, and update.sh refuses a symlink on every write path. The new output lines hold repo-relative paths only. update.sh still never pushes: its only git calls are add, diff --cached, and commit. The stable approval record and the README changed nothing since pass 1; the record rows equal the archive rows byte for byte, the PM weekly-refresh rule text is identical in the record and the README, and publish.ts is unchanged since pass 1. No key shape, key value, or private path appears in the range diff; no docs/ file changed; no harness/tests file changed. Review A passed at this HEAD with F15 fixed; the plan Green r7 evidence lines match my runs exactly. One new nonblocking nit: the Phase 2 verify commands in plan.md and test-strategy.md still name the old leak-check invocation; that command over-scans the real repo, so it cannot under-scan. The pass-1 empty-path refusal nit stays routed to tech debt and is not re-raised.
